label: Bible Study
prompt: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the _____ day according to the scriptures:
verse: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
note: Paul's gospel summary — buried, and risen the third day, just as the scriptures said.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And David behaved himself _____ in all his ways; and the LORD was with him.
verse: And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the LORD was with him.
note: Even as Saul grew jealous, David behaved wisely in all his ways — and the LORD was with him.

label: Sunday School
prompt: So that from his body were brought unto the sick _____ or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.
verse: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.
note: Even Paul's handkerchiefs and aprons carried healing in Ephesus — the most unusual laundry in Acts.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the _____ trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:
verse: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:
note: Peter's realism: fiery trials aren't a sign God lost the plot — they're the refiner at work.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the _____ men, though fools, shall not err therein.
verse: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.
note: The way of holiness is so plain that 'wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.' A highway even we can't miss.
